corrections.original_statement: For an emergency vehicle approaching from any direction, pull to the right edge or as close to the right as possible.

corrections.original_statement: If an emergency vehicle approaches while you are inside an intersection, clear the intersection before pulling over.

corrections.original_statement: Stop for a stopped school bus displaying flashing red lights whether it is beside your direction, opposite your direction or at the intersection you approach, except for the divided-road exception.

corrections.proposed_statement: Stop for a stopped school bus with flashing red lights on either side of the road or at an approaching intersection, except when an oncoming bus is separated from your roadway by a median or another physical barrier.

corrections.original_statement: You need not stop for an oncoming school bus when a median or other physical barrier separates the two directions of travel.

corrections.proposed_statement: The stop rule for a school bus with flashing red lights does not apply when the bus faces you across a median or other physical barrier separating the roadways.

corrections.original_statement: When circulating around a traffic island, keep to the island’s right side.
